Our Story

BUILT ON
QUALITY.
ZERO CUTS.

Year one. EZ Food Truck Battle. Four competitors. We won Best Food Truck by popular vote in both categories — 600+ people cast their votes. The community showed up and we showed out.

Every bun, every slice of cheese, every cut of meat chosen with intention. If we wouldn't serve it to our own family, we won't serve it to you.
